textual.limitations: The records do not establish actual earnings, user outcomes, required sign-up steps, payment flows, or whether any external site is used beyond listed YouTube links.

textual.limitations: The source records do not verify traffic sources, monetization eligibility, geographic targeting results, or whether the technique complies with platform rules.

The earning and traffic outcomes are unverified tutorial claims rather than a described deceptive solicitation.

This supports education, technology and operational demonstration rather than a defined scam mechanism.
